source.description: Original procedural SO-ARM-class desktop manipulator authored in this repository; joint topology and limits approximate a 6-servo hobby arm, and no external mesh or URDF was imported.

coordinateEvidence.forwardAxisReason: The generator authors the arm directly in the LK core convention; the fixed gripper jaw faces local +X at rest.
